Daruma Drop! Here's how the versus game works!{KP}The Pheasant lifts Momotaro-san, and the Sparrow lifts Kintaro-san,{KP}and they carry them up and down!{KP}Press the Circle button where you want to strike!{KP}The red bar sets your power!{KP}The longer the red bar, the harder you strike!{KP}Whoever knocks out all their blocks first wins!{KP}Or, if the timer hits 0, whoever has fewer blocks left wins!{KP}And what's more!{KP}Knock out two blocks at once, and your opponent gets more blocks!{KP}Knock out your blocks fast and get in their way!{KP}1P is Momotaro-san, 2P is Kintaro-san!
